text:
Jordan Li: starting a regional config-gate lift for ap-southeast-1 tonight 22:00 UTC. This is a gradual roll: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~45m. Leaving safe-defaults enabled until the 25% step. handoff to ops for smoke and rollback readiness.
Maria Gomez: quick Q — are we keeping the old routing fallback in place for 100ms spikes? also who owns the kill-switch? @Ryan_Ops? :eyes:
Sahil Patel: yep fallback stays. rollout plan: 
- 22:00: enable gate at 5% (canary tenants)
- 22:10: if smoke good, 25%
- 22:25: if metrics stable bump to 100%
Kill-switch = config.toggle.apse1.enable -> false (instant revert). logs + routing fallback remain.
deploy-bot: Scheduled config change: config.toggle.apse1.enable -> true at 1767805200 (22:00 UTC). Trigger: manual by Jordan Li.
Ryan_Ops: I'll run the smoke checks. checklist I'll follow:
```
# smoke checklist
1) curl -sS https://apse1-api.redwood.internal/health | jq .ok
2) curl -sS -X POST https://apse1-api.redwood.internal/predict -d '{"input":"smoke test"}' | jq .latency
3) check per-tenant error-rate on: https://console.redwood/internal/metrics?region=apse1&window=5m
```
I'll ping back in thread within 5m of each step. If error-rate > 1% or p95 latency +30% -> revert. :rotating_light:
Alice Chen: Will watch the dashboards and alerting. I set a temporary alert: apse1.feature-gate.errors > 0.8% for 3m -> page oncall. Also enabling trace sampling for the canary tenants so we have traces if problems. Link to runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/config-rollbacks#apse1
Jordan Li: thanks — tagging owners: @Maria Gomez (product), @Sahil Patel (eng runtime), @Ryan_Ops (ops). If smoke looks good at 25% we can remove safe-defaults (i.e., allow feature-specific behavior) but I want a quick post-bump verification window of 10m before 100%. :thumbsup:
Maria Gomez: acked. I'll be monitoring error analytics and customer pings. will call rollback if anything odd.
Sahil Patel: leaving a small note for on-call: do not change model-variant routing during the window. that'll invalidate the smoke comparison.
Ryan_Ops: starting 5% canary now (22:00). will report back in ~3m.
Jordan Li: copy, thanks everyone.
Ryan_Ops: 22:03 — canary smoke passed: health ok, p95 within baseline, errors 0.06%. bumping to 25%. :tada:
Maria Gomez: watching.
Ryan_Ops: 22:18 — 25% looks stable, no alerts. holding 10m then we'll go to 100%.
Jordan Li: prepping final rollout. if anything pops, revert command is: `curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood.internal/config -d '{"toggle":"config.toggle.apse1.enable","value":false}'`
Alice Chen: documented verification: dashboard panels refreshed, traces collected for canary tenants. I'll remove the temporary alert 30m after 100% if stable.
Ryan_Ops: 22:35 — bumped to 100%. monitoring closely.
Maria Gomez: thanks all. I'll send a short note in #prod-updates once metrics look green for 1h. :rocket:
